race_context: Lebanon Community School Corporation serves Lebanon and surrounding parts of Boone County, including Whitestown, with a preschool, four elementary schools, Lebanon Middle School and Lebanon High School {lcsc_home}{lcsc_min_0917}. Jon Milleman has been superintendent since 2019 {lcsc_leadership}. Enrollment was about 3,693 students on Sept. 11, 2026, about 40 below the district's forecast {lcsc_min_0917}.

The board of school trustees has five members elected by all voters in the district to four-year terms; members must live in set areas: one each from Center, Perry and Worth townships and two at large {lcsc_board_portal}. Current members are Jordan Clouser (president), Trey Hendrix (vice president), Brett Havlin (secretary), Craig Parks and Lisa Hutcheson {lcsc_board_portal}.

Seat on the 2026 ballot: one at-large seat, matching the state list's 'vote for 1' {boone_2026_list}{in_list}. It is held by Lisa Hutcheson, who won it in 2018 and was unopposed in 2022; she is not on the 2026 ballot, so the seat will have a new member {boone_2018}{boone_2022}{boone_2026_list}. The other at-large seat and the Center and Perry township seats were filled in 2024 {boone_2024}. In 2022 no candidate filed for the Worth Township seat, and the county's 2026 candidate list shows no Worth Township race {boone_2022}{boone_2026_list}.

Party labels: this is the first year Indiana school board candidates could declare a party when filing {chalkbeat_party}. The county list shows Haley (Hendrix) Shirley as a Republican and Chessany M. Edmonds with no party; the state lists Edmonds as Nonpartisan {boone_2026_list}{in_list}.

Budget and property taxes (2026): at a Sept. 15, 2026 budget hearing the board heard a parcel-level analysis of two options for 2027, one raising the operations fund and lowering the operating referendum rate and one doing the opposite; the consultant said the choice shifts tax burden between Lebanon and Whitestown taxpayers, and described how the 2025 property-tax law SEA 1 will limit growth in taxable value through 2031 {lcsc_min_0915}. Staff estimated the combined rate at about 91 cents under one model and 97 cents under the other, and no decision had been made as of Sept. 17 {lcsc_min_0917}. Adoption of the 2027 budget was on the Oct. 13, 2026 agenda {lcsc_agenda_1013}.

Referendums: voters approved an operating referendum in May 2022 at a rate of 15 cents; because taxable value has grown, the rate is 9 cents in 2026 {lcsc_min_0915}. The superintendent says it pays for school police, class sizes, the preschool, and art, music and PE teachers at every elementary school {lcsc_min_0915}. It expires in 2030, and district projections show a $5.4 million deficit starting in 2031 without a renewal or other revenue {lcsc_min_0917}. A 2022 capital referendum paid for a new elementary school, elementary renovations, a transportation center and a connector road {lcsc_min_0915}.

Growth and facilities: the district redrew elementary attendance lines after Perry-Worth Elementary reached about 96% capacity in May 2025; Clouser said the change caused problems for some families but added about 20% elementary capacity {lcsc_min_0917}. At a Sept. 17, 2026 joint session with the Lebanon and Whitestown councils, Clouser said forming a separate Whitestown school corporation would require state legislation and is not financially feasible, estimating $200–$250 million or more for a new K-12 system {lcsc_min_0917}. The board held a hearing on a 2027 general obligation bond project on Aug. 18, 2026, and the superintendent said the district will address athletic facility needs such as the six-lane track and original football bleachers {lcsc_agenda_0818}{lcsc_min_0915}.

Other business before the board in fall 2026: a tentative teacher contract (public meeting Oct. 13), a request to the state for a virtual school starting in 2027-28, a presentation on state A-F accountability grades, and a shortage of about four bus drivers each morning {lcsc_agenda_1013}{lcsc_min_0917}.
Forums: this guide found no 2026 candidate forum, questionnaire or news coverage for this race.
